name: ynab-mcp
description: MCP server for YNAB, packaged as a Claude Desktop extension

scripts.build: esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node22 --alias:fetch-ponyfill=./src/shims/fetch-ponyfill.cjs --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);" --outfile=server/index.js
scripts.inspect: npm run build && npx @modelcontextprotocol/inspector node server/index.js
scripts.pack: npm run build && mcpb pack . ynab-mcp.mcpb
